verdict.rationale: Hugging Face serves hosted models through Inference Providers, so a deprecation-policy axis applies. However, the evidence pack contains no documented deprecation policy, removal timeline, or advance-notice commitment for hosted models. Community complaints about library backward-compatibility concern Python libraries, not hosted model removal, so they are not relevant here.

support.subject: As a developer, I can rely on a documented deprecation policy with advance notice before a hosted model is removed
